wordings.text: Led ACERT architecture work for DARPA ARCOS, turning complex aerospace engineering documentation into queryable graph evidence.
Built document extraction systems that preserve source evidence and support deterministic review workflows.
Designed retrieval and receipt systems that separate source truth, inference, and human review decisions.

Built Sparta Explorer, an agentic space-cyber compliance workspace that traces conclusions from framework guidance (Aerospace SPARTA, NIST) to program evidence and human review, without giving the model approval authority.
Built extractor, an enhanced marker-pdf fork for advanced multi-format document processing with AI accuracy improvements.
Served as Executive Producer for web at RealPie, leading a team of about 12 people.
